e.body: 印尼金融服务管理局（Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, OJK）的英文「Insurance Statistics」页（`ojk.go.id/en/kanal/iknb/data-dan-statistik/asuransi/`）是**印尼保险业的官方统计与信息入口**，栏目覆盖保险、担保（surety）与养老基金三大板块：统计与数据、保险及辅助服务目录（institution directories）、牌照信息与出版物等。对 RIAA：印尼是**东南亚人口与保费体量最大的保险市场之一**，且处于快速增长与强监管重塑期，是亚洲市场研究的高频题目；本 wiki 的亚洲监管统计轴此前覆盖香港、中国、韩国、台湾、新加坡、澳洲、印度，东盟侧仅有新加坡——OJK 补齐了东盟最大市场；可与 [[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 做区域内对比，与 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]] 做全球口径对照；适合作新兴市场分析、区域比较与保险科技（[[openinsurance]] 一类的开放保险方向）研究。注意：该站为 SharePoint 门户，部分栏目以下载列表形式呈现。
e.body_en: The English "Insurance Statistics" section of Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, OJK; `ojk.go.id/en/kanal/iknb/data-dan-statistik/asuransi/`) is the **official statistics and information entry point for Indonesian insurance**, spanning insurance, surety and pension funds: statistics and data, institution directories for insurance and auxiliary services, licensing information and publications. For RIAA: Indonesia is **one of Southeast Asia’s largest insurance markets by population and premium**, and is in a phase of rapid growth and regulatory reshaping, making it a frequent subject of Asian market research; this wiki’s Asian regulatory-statistics axis previously covered Hong Kong, China, Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, Australia and India, with only Singapore in ASEAN — OJK fills in ASEAN’s largest market; compare within the region against [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]] and [[apra-insurance-statistics]], and globally against [[oecd-insurance-data]] and [[iais-gimar]]; suits emerging-market analysis, regional comparison and insurtech research in the open-insurance direction ([[openinsurance]]). Note: the site is a SharePoint portal and some sections are presented as download lists.
e.body_hk: 印尼金融服務管理局（Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, OJK）的英文「Insurance Statistics」頁（`ojk.go.id/en/kanal/iknb/data-dan-statistik/asuransi/`）是**印尼保險業的官方統計與資訊入口**，欄目覆蓋保險、擔保（surety）與養老基金三大板塊：統計與數據、保險及輔助服務目錄、牌照資訊與出版物等。對 RIAA：印尼是**東南亞人口與保費體量最大的保險市場之一**，且處於快速增長與強監管重塑期，是亞洲市場研究的高頻題目；本 wiki 的亞洲監管統計軸此前覆蓋香港、中國、韓國、台灣、新加坡、澳洲、印度，東盟側僅有新加坡——OJK 補齊了東盟最大市場；可與 [[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 做區域內對比，與 [[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[iais-gimar]] 做全球口徑對照；適合作新興市場分析與保險科技方向（[[openinsurance]]）研究。注意：該站為 SharePoint 門戶，部分欄目以下載列表形式呈現。
